answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the summit of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the relic re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The plume of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
